_README: x402-grounded-feedback-v0, grounding x402-receipt-commitment, opening public: the record publishes the salt, so anyone recomputes the receipt's authorizationCommitment and then checks the settlement exactly as for x402-settlement. Counted, deduplicated on (asset, payer, nonce). Check offline: node grounded-feedback/verify-test-vectors.mjs
signingKeyNote: Signed with the RFC 8032 section 7.1 TEST 1 ed25519 key: secret 9d61b19deffd5a60ba844af492ec2cc44449c5697b326919703bac031cae7f60, public d75a980182b10ab7d54bfed3c964073a0ee172f3daa62325af021a68f707511a. Publicly known, never used for anything real. TEST KEY ONLY.

notes.receipt: The signed receipt v2 payload from section 5 of the receipt spec (https://github.com/babyblueviper1/x402/blob/0e492d6730bef14b9c722428386c114f3475a914/specs/extensions/extension-offer-and-receipt.md). receiptHash is 0x + sha256 of its canonical JSON, the same bytes the private-opening statement's receipt_sha256 covers. The seller's receipt signature is out of scope here, as in the spec's own vectors.
notes.commitment: authorizationCommitment = 0x + sha256("x402-receipt-authorization/0" 0x00 "eip3009" 0x00 asset(20) authorizer(20) nonce(32) salt(32)). authorizer is the receipt's signed payer, never a value supplied with the salt (section 5.6.4 step 1).
notes.counting: Section 5.6.5: an unopened commitment is unique per receipt, not per payment, so a deduplicated or Sybil-resistant count counts opened commitments only.
notes.settlement: After the commitment opens, the settlementTx check is the x402-settlement one: status 1, and from the asset contract both AuthorizationUsed(payer, nonce) and Transfer(payer, payee, amount) in that receipt. settlementTx and payee here are placeholders; the receipt, asset, nonce and salt are the spec's example.
